description: Extract shared observability, services, and models from telegram_bot/ into src/ to fix the domain-to-transport layer violation described in issue ***REMOVED***1266. This moves code that src/ depends on into src/ itself, then makes telegram_bot/ re-export from src/ to preserve backward compatibility.
steps:
Step 1: Create `src/observability.py` - Extract the core observability primitives that src/ needs. This file should:
  - Import from langfuse SDK directly (with the same graceful degradation pattern as telegram_bot/observability.py)
  - Export: `observe`, `get_client`, `propagate_attributes`
  - Import PIIRedactor from src.security.pii_redaction and provide `mask_pii`
  - Include `initialize_langfuse`, `get_langfuse_client`, `traced_pipeline`, and `_reset_langfuse_client_for_tests` (these are used or could be used by src/ code)
  - Include `sync_langfuse_model_definitions` function
  - Include the warning filter `_install_langfuse_warning_filters`
  - Include the helper functions: `_resolve_config_value`, `_ensure_otel_service_name`, `_to_float`, `_normalize_unit`, `_normalize_datetime`, `_load_model_definitions_from_env`, `_model_definitions_equal`
  - Import `disable_otel_exporter` and `is_endpoint_reachable` from a new `src/observability_bootstrap.py`
  NOTE: Essentially move the FULL content of telegram_bot/observability.py into src/observability.py, changing only the import of `observability_bootstrap` to point to `src.observability_bootstrap`.

Step 2: Create `src/observability_bootstrap.py` - Move `telegram_bot/observability_bootstrap.py` content to `src/observability_bootstrap.py`. This is a small utility module with `is_endpoint_reachable` and `disable_otel_exporter` functions. The content is identical to the original.

Step 3: Create `src/observability_payloads.py` - Move the content of `telegram_bot/observability_payloads.py` to `src/observability_payloads.py`. This module imports `PIIRedactor` from `src.security.pii_redaction` (already in src/) and provides `build_safe_input_payload` and `build_safe_output_payload`.

Step 4: Create `src/services/` package with extracted service clients:
  - Create `src/services/__init__.py` with lazy imports matching the pattern in `telegram_bot/services/__init__.py` for the moved classes
  - Create `src/services/_retry.py` - Copy `telegram_bot/services/_retry.py` content (shared retry decorators: `bge_retry`, `kommo_retry`, `make_retry_decorator`)
  - Create `src/services/bge_m3_client.py` - Move the full content of `telegram_bot/services/bge_m3_client.py`, changing its import of `telegram_bot.observability` to `src.observability` and `telegram_bot.services._retry` to `src.services._retry`
  - Create `src/services/voyage.py` - Move the full content of `telegram_bot/services/voyage.py`, changing its import of `telegram_bot.observability` to `src.observability`

Step 5: Move `telegram_bot/services/apartment_models.py` to `src/models/apartment.py`:
  - Create `src/models/apartment.py` with the full content of `telegram_bot/services/apartment_models.py` (it has no telegram_bot imports - it's pure data models)
  - The file uses only pydantic and dataclasses - no layer dependencies

Step 6: Update `telegram_bot/observability.py` to re-export from `src.observability`:
  - Replace the entire body with imports from `src.observability` and re-exports
  - It must still export all the same public names: `observe`, `get_client`, `propagate_attributes`, `mask_pii`, `initialize_langfuse`, `get_langfuse_client`, `create_callback_handler`, `traced_pipeline`, `sync_langfuse_model_definitions`, `_reset_langfuse_client_for_tests`
  - Keep `create_callback_handler` in telegram_bot/observability.py since it imports from langfuse.langchain (LangChain callback is bot-specific)
  - Re-export pattern: `from src.observability import observe, get_client, propagate_attributes, mask_pii, initialize_langfuse, get_langfuse_client, traced_pipeline, sync_langfuse_model_definitions, _reset_langfuse_client_for_tests`

Step 7: Update `telegram_bot/observability_bootstrap.py` to re-export from `src.observability_bootstrap`:
  - Replace the body with: `from src.observability_bootstrap import is_endpoint_reachable, disable_otel_exporter`

Step 8: Update `telegram_bot/observability_payloads.py` to re-export from `src.observability_payloads`:
  - Replace the body with: `from src.observability_payloads import build_safe_input_payload, build_safe_output_payload`

Step 9: Update `telegram_bot/services/bge_m3_client.py` to re-export from `src.services.bge_m3_client`:
  - Replace the body with imports from `src.services.bge_m3_client` re-exporting all public names: `BGEM3Client`, `BGEM3SyncClient`, `DenseResult`, `SparseResult`, `HybridResult`, `RerankResult`, `ColbertResult`, plus constants `DEFAULT_TIMEOUT`, `DEFAULT_BATCH_SIZE`, `DEFAULT_MAX_LENGTH`, `BGE_M3_MODEL_NAME`

Step 10: Update `telegram_bot/services/voyage.py` to re-export from `src.services.voyage`:
  - Replace the body with: `from src.services.voyage import VoyageService`

Step 11: Update `telegram_bot/services/_retry.py` to re-export from `src.services._retry`:
  - Replace the body with imports from `src.services._retry` re-exporting: `make_retry_decorator`, `kommo_retry`, `bge_retry`, `RETRYABLE_TRANSPORT_ERRORS`, `RETRYABLE_HTTP_STATUS_CODES`

Step 12: Update `telegram_bot/services/apartment_models.py` to re-export from `src.models.apartment`:
  - Replace the body with imports from `src.models.apartment` re-exporting all public names: `ApartmentRecord`, `ApartmentQueryParseResult`, `compute_confidence`, `normalize_view`, `HardFilters`, `SoftPreferences`, `ExtractionMeta`, `ApartmentSearchFilters`

Step 13: Update all `src/` files to import from the new `src.*` locations instead of `telegram_bot.*`:
  - `src/ingestion/unified/observability.py`: change `from telegram_bot.observability import get_client, observe, propagate_attributes` to `from src.observability import get_client, observe, propagate_attributes`
  - `src/voice/observability.py`: change `from telegram_bot.observability import get_client, observe, propagate_attributes` to `from src.observability import get_client, observe, propagate_attributes`
  - `src/retrieval/reranker.py`: change `from telegram_bot.observability import get_client, observe` to `from src.observability import get_client, observe`
  - `src/ingestion/unified/qdrant_writer.py`: change `from telegram_bot.services.bge_m3_client import BGEM3SyncClient` to `from src.services.bge_m3_client import BGEM3SyncClient` and `from telegram_bot.services import VoyageService` to `from src.services.voyage import VoyageService`
  - `src/ingestion/unified/colbert_backfill.py`: change `from telegram_bot.services.bge_m3_client import BGEM3SyncClient` to `from src.services.bge_m3_client import BGEM3SyncClient`
  - `src/ingestion/apartments/flow.py`: change `from telegram_bot.services.apartment_models import ApartmentRecord` to `from src.models.apartment import ApartmentRecord`
  - `src/ingestion/apartments/source.py`: change `from telegram_bot.services.apartment_models import ApartmentRecord` to `from src.models.apartment import ApartmentRecord`
  - `src/ingestion/apartments/runner.py`: change `from telegram_bot.services.apartment_models import ApartmentRecord` to `from src.models.apartment import ApartmentRecord` (both TYPE_CHECKING and runtime) and `from telegram_bot.services.bge_m3_client import BGEM3SyncClient` to `from src.services.bge_m3_client import BGEM3SyncClient`
  - `src/ingestion/cocoindex_flow.py`: change `from telegram_bot.services import VoyageService` to `from src.services.voyage import VoyageService`
  - `src/api/main.py`: change `from telegram_bot.observability import observe` to `from src.observability import observe`, change `from telegram_bot.observability_payloads import (build_safe_input_payload, build_safe_output_payload)` to `from src.observability_payloads import (build_safe_input_payload, build_safe_output_payload)`. NOTE: Keep the lazy imports of `telegram_bot.graph.config`, `telegram_bot.graph.graph`, `telegram_bot.integrations.cache`, and `telegram_bot.services.qdrant` in the lifespan function - those are runtime graph/cache concerns beyond the scope of this issue's shared-code extraction. Also update the inline `from telegram_bot.observability import get_client` and `from telegram_bot.observability import get_client, propagate_attributes` inside function bodies to use `from src.observability import ...`.
  - In `src/api/main.py` function `_execute_query`: change `from telegram_bot.observability import get_client, propagate_attributes` to `from src.observability import get_client, propagate_attributes`. Also change `from telegram_bot.scoring import write_langfuse_scores` - this one stays since scoring is a bot-layer concern.
  - In `src/api/main.py` function `_resolve_trace_id`: change `from telegram_bot.observability import get_client` to `from src.observability import get_client`
  - In `src/api/main.py` function `_normalize_langfuse_trace_id`: change `from telegram_bot.observability import get_client` to `from src.observability import get_client`
  - In `src/api/main.py` function `_query_with_explicit_trace`: change `from telegram_bot.observability import get_client` to `from src.observability import get_client`

Step 14: Update `telegram_bot/services/__init__.py` - Ensure the lazy import map still works. The entries for `BGEM3Client`, `BGEM3SyncClient`, and `VoyageService` should still point to `.bge_m3_client` and `.voyage` respectively (since those files now re-export from src/). No changes needed if re-exports are working.

Step 15: Update test patches. Tests that patch `telegram_bot.observability.*` or `src.ingestion.unified.observability.get_client` etc. need to still work. Since src/ingestion/unified/observability.py now imports from src.observability, the patches in tests/unit/ingestion/test_observability.py that patch `src.ingestion.unified.observability.get_client` will still work correctly because they patch at the import location. Review and fix any test files that directly patch `telegram_bot.observability` in the context of src/ tests:
  - No changes should be needed for tests/unit/ingestion/test_observability.py since it patches at the consumer module level
  - tests/unit/test_observability.py tests telegram_bot.observability.mask_pii - this should still work since telegram_bot/observability.py re-exports from src.observability

Step 16: Run verification:
  - `uv run ruff check src/ telegram_bot/` to verify no lint issues
  - `uv run ruff format --check src/ telegram_bot/` to verify formatting
  - Run `grep -rn 'from telegram_bot' src/` to verify remaining cross-imports are only the acceptable ones (graph, cache, scoring, qdrant service in src/api/main.py lifespan)
  - Run the unit test suite to verify nothing is broken
acceptance_criteria: No `from telegram_bot.observability` imports in any src/ file (all use `from src.observability`)
No `from telegram_bot.services.bge_m3_client` imports in any src/ file (all use `from src.services.bge_m3_client`)
No `from telegram_bot.services.voyage` or `from telegram_bot.services import VoyageService` imports in any src/ file (all use `from src.services.voyage`)
No `from telegram_bot.services.apartment_models` imports in any src/ file (all use `from src.models.apartment`)
No `from telegram_bot.observability_payloads` imports in any src/ file (all use `from src.observability_payloads`)
telegram_bot/observability.py re-exports from src.observability so existing telegram_bot/ consumers are not affected
Ruff lint passes on src/ and telegram_bot/
verification: uv run ruff check src/ telegram_bot/
uv run ruff format --check src/ telegram_bot/

PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 uv run --python 3.12 pytest tests/unit/ --ignore=tests/unit/test_document_parser.py --ignore=tests/unit/test_evaluator.py --ignore=tests/unit/evaluation/test_ragas_evaluation.py --ignore=tests/unit/voice/test_sip_setup.py --ignore=tests/unit/voice/test_voice_agent.py --ignore=tests/unit/ingestion/test_cocoindex_init.py --ignore=tests/unit/ingestion/test_qdrant_hybrid_target.py --ignore=tests/unit/ingestion/test_qdrant_hybrid_target_helpers.py --ignore=tests/unit/ingestion/test_qdrant_hybrid_target_state_paths.py --ignore=tests/unit/ingestion/test_target_sync_execution.py --ignore=tests/unit/ingestion/test_unified_cli.py --ignore=tests/unit/ingestion/test_unified_flow.py --ignore=tests/unit/ingestion/test_unified_flow_wiring.py -n auto --dist=worksteal -q --timeout=30 -m 'not legacy_api and not requires_extras and not slow'

grep -rn 'from telegram_bot' src/ | grep -v 'src/api/main.py' | grep -v '__pycache__' should return empty (all layer violations fixed except the graph/cache/scoring ones in api/main.py that are out of scope)
